title: Proven site upgrade: agent skills for TYPO3
description: Upgrade a whole site from TYPO3 v12 or v13 to 14.3 LTS in a local DDEV copy, and prove that visitors see no difference. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 85 seconds: Proven site upgrade, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-upgrade-run, typo3-upgrade-intake, typo3-upgrade-baseline, typo3-upgrade-closure). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: An upgrade is done when visitors see no difference. Can you prove it?
Proven site upgrade: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Upgrades a site from v12 or v13 to 14.3 LTS and proves that visitors see no difference.
The final proof of a real run: 360 screenshots, no undeclared difference.
A read-only preflight of repository, runtime, database, files, extensions and risks.
An upgrade that starts from the wrong database proves nothing.
Captures responses, HTML and screenshots of the untouched site and seals them as Baseline A.
A comparison is only as good as its reference.
Compares the upgraded site with the baseline and closes only when nothing unexplained changed.
It never accepts an unexplained difference and never refreshes the baseline to make one disappear.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
